official_applications.subject: Request for Urgent Repair of a Faulty Fan
official_applications.body:
Respected Ma’am,

With due respect, I would like to inform you that I have been facing a problem with a faulty fan for the last 15 days. I have already submitted a complaint regarding this issue, but unfortunately, no solution has been provided yet.

Due to the ongoing hot weather, it has become very difficult for me to stay and study comfortably without a working fan. Despite waiting for the past 15 days, the problem remains unresolved, causing considerable inconvenience.

Therefore, I kindly request you to look into this matter and arrange for the fan to be repaired as soon as possible. I would be very grateful for your prompt action and support.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Yours obediently,
Anshu Kumar
